visual.general_description: Horizontal clinical timeline graphic with ten dated nodes from POD 0 to 4 months after surgery.
visual.detailed_description: A blue gradient horizontal arrow runs left to right with ten circular nodes. Above the line, from left: POD 1 (cough with sputum production and chest tightness; chest CT with newly developed infectious changes compared with prior imaging; intravenous antibiotic therapy initiated), POD 4 evening (altered mental status; respiratory distress necessitating mechanical ventilation; sepsis diagnosed), POD 10 (respiratory status improved; endotracheal tube extubated; continued pelvic irrigation; inflammatory markers decreased), POD 26 (discharged from the hospital) and 4 Months After Surgery (successful ileostomy reversal performed). Below the line, from left: POD 0 (Altemeier procedure under spinal anesthesia), POD 4 (rectal bleeding; CT confirmed anastomotic leakage; terminal ileostomy and insertion of a self-designed double-lumen irrigation-drainage catheter), POD 9 (CT showed partial resolution of pneumatosis in the abdominopelvic cavity and abdominal wall), POD 14 (CT demonstrated further resolution of abdominopelvic pneumatosis and minimal residual ascitic fluid) and 1 Week After Discharge (irrigation-drainage catheter successfully removed). No dates, patient identifiers or numeric measurements are printed.
